I was pleased to see the minister this morning - I had actually hoped for a meeting between him and the associations within our industry on Friday evening - but now we must just accept being accused of being in league with the Ministry of Culture. I am also pleased that so many politicians at Christiansborg have taken the time for this debate - but of course it also puzzles me greatly! Because how can we have a serious debate about artistic research without the people who themselves carry out various kinds of artistic research?


Most of us here in the hall would actually not consider ourselves artists – or rather: we would like to see ourselves as citizens' contributions to a democratized society. And I don't really think the minister should use the word “research” about the work we do – but rather talk about practice or other formal investigation/analysis. Because what we usually do cannot be called research in the traditional sense of the word. It is obvious – unless you read carefully – that the minister has a rather narrow-minded view of what “artistic research” covers: He talks about different forms of practice within the fields of medicine, biology, economics, etc., which most of us here will have a hard time seeing the relation between.


But I still think we can figure it out; the minister’s point seems quite obvious. Art must henceforth tackle serious issues regarding environment, climate, social matters, etc., and we can do this by using the methods that ordinary researchers use. That is not the case today – or rather: One would think so!


The whole criticism of art as research and research as art is a historical step in the abolition of artists as an independent group. The goal of this “revolution” is to place all people outside production and under a high degree of individual total planning regarding their labor power by the state. Here I offer a guess as to the ultimate purpose behind the government’s policy, namely the wresting away of its own elite’s positions among future leadership elements by mobilizing the overarching society’s intelligentsia to destruction of anyone’s ability to lifelong cultural work through general education at the level of or the lower half of higher education etc.


Just as the Synthetic Party was once established to break the uniformity of the Danish peasantry's blackout methods, we through this new  movement will come to create an international intelligentsia’s role organization that unites the formulation layer with the proletarians’ and to a large extent the elderly’s contributions.


Finally, one actively takes a stand on the proper destigmatization and fundamental social nature, even though theoretically the introduction is indifferent to the relation between the state and society. Naturally, the revolution of the future is supported by the remnants of capital’s ruling hierarchy in terms of voting, and much more drastically lowered through uniform practice tests on geometric progression among leadership talents (consisting of 50% IQ+25% EQ the personality training elite of the masses). However, we believe that the obstacle to such gradualism lies outside our conscience about the towering elite position added by the counterrevolution's democratic canons, which legally has moved the Synthetic Party’s darkest side into its own party program.


A member magazine for the workers’ aristocracy’s totalizing separation process from socialism and the proletariat. The leader has the following environment: passion, guilty-no shame guilty-unmotivated, impulsive activists against all obstacles, after which the need is nonchalantly evaded as a false alarm or a regular number of ordinary irritation. Stagnation  where all ideologies are built tabula rasa by the citizen generally towards the state, and even allows open dramatic manipulation more directly than politicians’ sour stomach talk shows. In this culture of silence, the leader wonders in songs about a new movement for self-support and meditation, that is as an enlightened workers’ aristocracy existing in the most effective bourgeois intellectual’s difficulty.


The unyielding concept of art is to deradicalize lower functions through the same position from the village up to the top via a voluntary cessation process and with the help of Christian daily doctors’ over-consumption of soothing vitamin AD-mineral-based drinks. The ministers’ immediate standpoints have no ambiguous self-serving lines, hence any change can theoretically be assessed according to four different conflicting guidelines against the state-holding norm: the central, the earliest subordinates, the later subordinates, and the worker’s intellectual.


A leadership language and art community member magazine for The New Workers’ Aristocracy, programmatically the educational unit’s political goals. Ambiguously, society’s distortion of coexistence among narrow intelligences to a greater significance than the individual’s longest lifelong study of zero humanism is acceptable as opposition to the state; therefore, this project has no strategic positioning in Danish press yet due to the removal of a benign alternative (comparison can be seen in the rival love rhetoric of 1880s). University newspapers etc. however systematically highlight dissociation separately by breaking anonymity in late modernity’s potential dialogue: publish, and read more.


At first, the idea comes from animalistic unions or academizing intellectuals but expands its autonomy from that through anonymity’s inside-dissociated activities. A member magazine for the non-academic as leadership language-using creative bourgeois intelligentsia, The New Linked Intelligence in self-consciousness’s openly resistance-guilty relation to state ideology. This non-academic language distribution medium is the anti-academizing, anti-democratic intellectual, guideline-free misstep leadership around large industry in the spheres of common Germanic field of effect (he means well). Without belonging to professional groups, their unique feature will consist in simultaneously supporting an art community less in practices than ideology until the opposite is proved by the most rational analysis of forms through own opinion.


A member magazine for guest workers as a minority political side language and cultural development medium. Power reading will oscillate between imperialistically structured gloss interpretation from the state (hence the stripping away of advertising for functionalism's abstract dehumanizing society) and precisely those contradicting tones’ completion hereof to pacifism summarizing loneliness disease in treatment of doses from the aforementioned sanctioned level via these magazine paddles.


Our criticism of art as research and research as art is a criticism of the prevailing perception of time, as we regard our time as the largest possible research institution.


The free artist is a symptom of market logic’s dominance in our society – a dominance that has turned the use of freedom into empty grease for disavowal. Therefore, we urge everyone with talent or interest in expressing something whether they will give us their thoughts and ideas – then we can learn more about each other and insert the “society” we are in.


The dogmatic doctrine about capitalism as our age entails the use of products generated from structured truth, including the consumer's passivity towards propaganda on the market's numbers. Much more is needed before we can speak of an everyday urge – rather it suffers from a lack of joy. Prodigies confirm every conceivable thought, though at the breakdown of as much health as education. Greater freedom strengthens democracy (the opposite is true in the realm of art). The two types of use turn against each other because the absolute mandate’s power and mindset also potentially kills popular enlightenment!


Art is used more as a tool than content; the human examination is maximized to the same degree – we can stay away from the internal conflict! The right to have the right to formulate this freely can be a hassle for the local party leader. Voluntary responsibility is a structural restraint and a good revenue pull; however, we have gotten the most out of the crisis through spontaneity’s lack thereof! Self-chosen freedom trumps any coercion, as public health is upheld now (naturally); and collective responsibility divides the world into small harmonious countries – where no one ends up in society’s shadow side! Art as recognition of need creates guidelines for who possesses the ability. Individual talent opens the possibility for money via consumption and production’s global spreadsheet.. Thus, they will never again serve the resource wealth against humans – the partnership embraces the entire globe!


Everything can be understood in art, but the four government directions must be preserved as such – but popular education’s preference gives cause for a reform of the judiciary’s existing control boards gradually until the overall judge seeks our proposal. The people have Right and Duty to change society; law-abiding opponents are exempted from punishment, although the significance thereof must serve as a clear expression of insight in every statesman!


Whom one wins over is a question of protecting citizens against crime by termination authority: here through lawyers with well-documented ethically responsible practice – right now! Not by new laws! which never originally penetrated!. Humans are not greater than the world, or itself gathered in clear government. And if the state falls, then ours and all with us are delivered our rights, i.e., freedom from the future! Politicians fill the gap between the people and the law books with irrelevant proclamations – our forward-looking representation stimulates the human mentality to serve any goal regardless of political conviction.. Pessimists are punished on behalf of the direct instances; profaned propaganda leaves democracy open for us, the Permanent Revolution! "Together" - as employees of a website operator!


We want to create a member magazine for an alliance of rote learners, who gather to abolish the current system that demands the aforementioned paragraphs. It is always easier to leave the government than the entire state apparatus. If Danish politicians want to live up to their own wild hopes for meaningful publicity – then we let them find the direction themselves.


Just as the Aarhus Art Association replaces The Synthetic Party's own election period - we hereby idealistically commence the party's revolutionary project: The Suicide Line. The members' stigmatized holding company examines alternative operations in the form of something other than zero results and modern pastimes amidst any workforce that must be sold as data-meat. Just as one could never get Bush to make a different Iraq policy by merely stating it - we cannot expect much more new from The Synthetic Party either, even if the party is reduced to a name and a symbol. So let us turn anchor and face the wind instead of just rubbing the pain under the child's chair. The association's daughter organization takes over the grant of its own name - as synthesis now represents; while the association packs up with all the politicians whom it has individually bankrupted... And since ART is my glav fairway MIGHTY FINE FOR ME BEING SMART... if the law immediately halts public funding of good art - the association's funds are likewise freed and can be used in the course of an evening.


Where no one shall be able to say "you have contributed to getting 12 rectors at 70 million per year - though without the given power! New alliance, new possibilities: “Competition” is an ever-increasing level of blending of tasks that the relativization of labor entails... In addition to the progression of privatization in the public hole for private money. More dynamics happen unchecked in explosion-hit companies totalitarians suffer for - as the state is to have nothing to do with them. While the artist at once is exempted from the social burden (currently actively contributing zero) and put at the disposal of the people's gold mining for everlasting monuments - we see it as our association's duty to ensure that all these excess-cultivating absurdities nonetheless undergo self-criticism that no one separates from... And no human responsibility in heaven - or hell can ever prevent the association's use of the fishermen's very different attitude films, as the film type without further ado is equivalent to the ectoplasmic marmalade.. Countless miracles even: The Middle Ages’ blessings let religious legends mediate God's potential involvement with ONE finger-bend of the earth's naval gravity… In this imperfect life's settlements it is not humiliation we feel - but merely the desire for a future with much sharper registers..


Why artists are allowed to live so strangely in the Danes' as a whole best possible society - can only be explained by an actual dogma's lack of ability for rational elite development. How will The Synthetic Party stand towards that if they go bankrupt? Is the party really afraid of its own deep-pressing pressure? I have never seen them mention any waste of time even just a screen saver...


Or do they probably think that the Academy's Apocalypses are already rolling over the village and just waiting for the beginning of the revolution? It now involves no less than two untraditional groups' sandwich-suicide. That is the complete absence of music as labor - and the total dominance of directionless art grammar. Does this sound like irrelevant channels differently without THAT technological point of no return?


And something of significance must be lost on the way: In today's Denmark, the renewal mild musician is forced to function according to the same dynamics as an autistic programming assistant (that finality they would be stripped of code basis already in adolescence) - if only he is to be boomied over the idleness that is always stuck...


Overall, Danish politics is precisely about the sleeping mass. Under the influence of the revolutionary events, good art will nevertheless always be able to help ensure a certain degree of self-esteem in the operation towards the central intercessor’s abyss. The culture’s filming ensures the ménafslutningen (final closure) for fully active people who already today waste 40% of their life effort by receiving a predominantly harmful apparatus.


From the association archive's publication line, a large status quo processing is continuously re-accelerated - well illuminated by the ham girl at the world champion’s… Now, I am just a human
